visible.author: Ats1717

Free mount and balance. TPS sensors and lug nuts were no brainer add. All arrived in 2 days in five huge boxes. Mounting and weight placement was very clean. Could not ask for a better buying experience. Kind of nervous with the amount of money spent to order through the mail. Felt bad for the UPS guy who delivered it. Free shipping??? Almost did not post pictures because I don’t want to start seeing these rims everywhere.
